summary_en: BuySell Technologies will acquire all shares of HKS Victory Japan Co., Ltd., which operates 20 "Kaitori Senmon Tokyo Market" stores primarily in Kyushu and Kanto regions, to strengthen regional dominance strategy in secondhand goods retail. The transaction will establish HKS Victory Japan as a wholly owned subsidiary, with the real estate rental business separated prior to closing.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Shares in HKS Victory Japan Co., Ltd. (Complete Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
BuySell Technologies announced on September 17, 2026, that its board of directors has approved the acquisition of all shares in HKS Victory Japan Co., Ltd., a secondhand goods retailer operating 20 "Kaitori Senmon Tokyo Market" outlets primarily across Kagoshima Prefecture and the Kanto region. The acquisition will make HKS Victory Japan a wholly owned subsidiary. Prior to closing, the target company's real estate rental business will be separated from the group, with only the core reuse operations being integrated.

HKS Victory Japan generated 2,329 million yen in revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026, with operating profit of 89 million yen and net profit of 56 million yen. The company is 100% owned by Hideyuki Nishimoto. The acquisition represents part of BuySell Technologies' medium-term expansion strategy, following the complete acquisition of DelightZ in April 2026, another Kyushu-based secondhand goods store operator. BuySell Technologies intends to leverage the target company's strong local brand recognition and customer base in Kagoshima, combined with group capabilities and synergies, to strengthen its regional dominance strategy in secondhand goods retail and expand store presence in the Kyushu area where the group currently has limited operations.
